1859.d: The Bandit Camp is a town located in the Kharidian Desert.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Use a Bandit camp teleport scroll
• Use the Enlightened amulet teleport to arrive north of the camp
• Use the Bandit camp lodestone and run north-west (this requires completion of Desert Treasure)
• Take a Magic carpet ride to Bedabin camp and run south
• Players with access to the Fairy ring network can use the code BIQ to the Kalphite Hive and run south-west
• Use the camulet or cramulet teleport to arrive outside Enakhra's Temple and run north
